schema.schemaVersion: Major shape of this file. 3 adds $schema, schema (this guide) and downloads; 2 added theme and marketing; 1 is the bare product record.
schema.$schema: The published JSON Schema for this file, so editors validate the kit as you type.
schema.schema: This block: every field of assets.json explained. Structure comes from lib/kit-doc.ts in the site repo — edit structure there, prose here.
schema.product.slug: URL-safe identifier; the site route is /work/<slug>/ and the press kit /press/<slug>/.
schema.product.name: Display name, spelled exactly as press.naming requires.
schema.product.category: "app" or "tool" — sorts the card into the two landing groups.
schema.product.headline.lead: First half of the headline duet.
schema.product.headline.lift: The italic-serif half of the headline. Required.
schema.product.tagline: One line under the headline on the card.
schema.product.summary: Longer one-liner for the product page hero and press kit.
schema.product.platform: Long-form platform string for the fact rows.
schema.product.licence.label: How the licence reads on the card.
schema.product.licence.kind: oss | free | paid — drives the label ink and JSON-LD offers.
schema.product.licence.price: Price line for the fact rows.
schema.product.licence.pricePoint: For kind "paid": the fragment that costs money, e.g. "$5 Pro".
schema.product.distribution: Where it is installed from, as a phrase.
schema.product.mono: Fallback monogram for an icon-less kit; null when an icon exists.
schema.links.repo: The repository's real https:// URL — the fetch script resolves it directly.
schema.links.store: Optional store listing (Mac App Store). Shown as a fact row and the hero fallback badge.
schema.press.short: One-paragraph boilerplate for the press kit.
schema.press.long: Full boilerplate; also closes the product page facts.
schema.press.naming: How to spell the product name in print.
schema.theme.accent: v2+. Per-app accent as a bare HSL triplet ("H S% L%"), contrast-gated at validation.
schema.marketing.sections: v2+. Ordered typed sections the product page renders through one renderer; kinds: features, steps, stats, showcase, table, faq, prose, terminal.
schema.downloads: v3+. 1-4 real ways to get the product. The FIRST entry must be url-based — it renders as the hero primary button. Absent = the hero falls back to the repository link.
schema.downloads[].label: Button or chip text.
schema.downloads[].kind: appstore | releases | dmg | zip | exe | appimage | website | repo (url-based) or brew | script (command-based).
schema.downloads[].url: https:// URL, required for url-based kinds.
schema.downloads[].command: Copyable install command, required for brew/script.
schema.downloads[].note: Optional caveat shown near the CTA.
schema.assets: Every art file, flat basenames only, with role, label, note and MEASURED width/height (fetch re-measures and throws on mismatch).
schema.assets[].role: icon-card | icon-press | icon-vector | screenshot | screenshot-localized | lockup | hero | diagram | benchmark | terminal. icon-* / screenshot / lockup are singletons; screenshot-localized may repeat, once per language.
schema.assets[].file: Flat basename sitting next to this assets.json.
schema.assets[].label: Caption shown in the press kit.
schema.assets[].note: Format note on the download badge, e.g. "PNG".

product.name: PrayerTimes Pro
product.summary: A menu-bar prayer times app for macOS. Eighteen calculation methods, five languages, a prayer log that tracks streaks and make-ups, and every time computed on your own Mac.

press.short: PrayerTimes Pro keeps accurate prayer times a glance away in the macOS menu bar, with 18+ calculation methods, five languages and a prayer log, computed on the Mac itself.
press.long: PrayerTimes Pro puts accurate prayer times a glance away in the macOS menu bar. It supports more than eighteen calculation methods and five languages, and every time is computed on the Mac itself — so it stays right wherever you are, and keeps working with no connection. Beyond the times it keeps a prayer log with streaks and make-ups, a Qibla compass, a Hijri calendar, full-screen alerts and a library of adhan recordings. The signed, notarized .dmg and the Homebrew cask ship every feature unlocked and free; the Mac App Store build sells the same features as a $5 one-time Pro unlock.
press.naming: Written "PrayerTimes Pro" — one word for the product name, capital P and T, with "Pro" as a separate word. Never "Prayer Times" or "Prayertimes".

items.title: 18+ calculation methods
items.body: Muslim World League, ISNA, Egyptian General Authority, Umm al-Qura, Diyanet, Karachi, Tehran, Dubai, Qatar, Singapore, Kuwait, Algeria, France, Germany, Malaysia and more, with per-prayer adjustments and custom angles.

items.title: Five languages, full RTL
items.body: English, Arabic, Indonesian, Farsi and Urdu. The interface mirrors properly, not just the strings.

items.title: A prayer log that means something
items.body: Mark each prayer as you pray it. Streaks, make-up (qada) tracking, and a day that rolls over at Fajr, not midnight.

items.title: Qibla compass
items.body: Points to the Kaaba from wherever you are, beside the times it belongs to.

items.title: Adhan library
items.body: Recordings from 28 countries, a separate adhan for Fajr, quiet hours and per-prayer announcements.

items.title: Hijri calendar
items.body: Adjustable date, with notifications for Ramadan, both Eids, the Islamic New Year and Ashura.

sections.caption: The timeline with countdown and streak, a full-screen alert, and Settings.
The Arabic build — the whole interface mirrors, not just the strings. Farsi, Urdu and Indonesian strips are in the press kit.

sections.heading: Your location stays yours
sections.body:
Every time is computed on the Mac itself. There is no server that learns where you are, no account, and nothing that stops working when the network does — the same machine that shows the times is the one that calculated them.

Two builds, one app. The direct .dmg and the Homebrew cask are signed and notarized, update themselves through Sparkle, and ship every feature unlocked and free. The Mac App Store build sells the same features as a $5 one-time Pro unlock — the prayer log with streaks and make-ups, the animated prayer scenes, and the full adhan library. Everything else is free there too.

sections.heading: Install with Homebrew
sections.note: The cask and the .dmg are the same build — every feature unlocked, free, updates via Sparkle. If macOS quarantines the download: xattr -r -d com.apple.quarantine /Applications/PrayerTimes.app

items.a: No. Times are computed on the Mac, so the app keeps working entirely offline — travel included, since the location it uses is yours, locally.

items.q: Which calculation method should I pick?
items.a: Whichever your locality follows. Eighteen-plus methods ship built in with custom angles on top; the common ones for each region are listed in the README.
The prayer log with streaks and make-up tracking, the animated prayer scenes, and the full 28-country adhan library. It is a one-time $5 — no subscription.
Yes — a native menu-bar app for macOS, Apple Silicon and Intel, from the Mac App Store or a signed dmg.

items.q: Direct download, Homebrew, or the App Store?
items.a: The App Store build is the recommended path if you want purchases and updates handled there. The direct .dmg and the Homebrew cask are the same app — signed, notarized, every feature unlocked for free, with updates delivered by Sparkle.
